visualCharacteristics.purpose: app promotion: text column with icon feature items and CTA beside a large (animated) image
visualCharacteristics.description: Black background, 48px top padding. Centered KFC APP logo on top; left column: large white headline, paragraph with bold #pebune, 2 icon+text bullet items, red CTA 'Descarcă aplicația'; right column: animated GIF of the app offers.

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells; text cell = optional logo image paragraph first, heading, paragraph, icon + text paragraphs (feature items), CTA link; media cell = image only (GIF kept as authored, not re-optimised)
contentPattern.description: Side-by-side layout: app promo text with icon bullets and CTA beside a large animated image.

usage: App download promo inside a dark section.
reuseGuidance: Use for text + image two-column promos where paragraphs starting with an icon should render as feature items.
